finding: Strict success is not spread thinly across the test set -- it is concentrated in one bucket. Stratifying by terminal-pair PRECISION (the over-merge axis) gives a sharply bimodal population: images at precision >= 0.9 average 0.98 terminal-pair F1 and convert to strict success 85% of the time, while EVERY image below 0.9 converts 0%. All 67 strict successes come from the top bucket.
why_precision_not_recall: On the failing images recall stays moderate (mean 0.51 below precision 0.5) while precision collapses. The conductors ARE being found; they are fused into too few nets. So the residual error is over-merging, not missing ink -- consistent with the oracle's post-snapping-fix per-component attribution of detection 0.0627, wires 0.3406, snapping 0.0028.

implied_target.note: Illustrative ceiling, not a prediction: it assumes images moved above 0.9 precision would convert at the same 85% the existing top bucket does. It identifies WHERE the work is -- roughly 62 specific images whose conductors are already found and merely need separating -- rather than promising a number.
